# Schemes

| Scheme | For | Avoid when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Accessible first](accessible-first.md) | Large text, large targets and AAA contrast, so everyone can finish the task. | Dense expert tools where screen space matters more than size. |
| [Brand expressive](brand-expressive.md) | Big display type, vivid color and springy motion, for launches that must be remembered. | Tools people use for hours, or forms where calm matters more than character. |
| [Content first](content-first.md) | Large, calm type and generous space, for people who come to read. | Data-heavy tools or screens with many actions. |
| [Dense data](dense-data.md) | Compact, exact and quiet, for experts who scan and compare numbers all day. | Public sites, reading products, or first-time visitors on phones. |
| [Multi-brand](multi-brand.md) | One shared system with three brands as themes. Components never change; brand primitives do. | A single product with one brand: the brand layer is cost with no user. |
